title: NILS purpose registry entry
description: Wave 4c section 8.3 (D44): a purpose is registered by an app in Kvasir's configuration, never invented by a caller. Its content class bounds what it may carry; every backend has a locality; the policy table maps a purpose to a backend.

content_class.description: catalog: names, axis values, describe sentences, the person's words. rows: handle rows, counts, sampled values, funnels, review evidence. identifiers: anything that projects out.identifiers or reaches the linkage store.

kind.description: foreground calls retry capacity errors, background calls bail at once

refusal_layer.description: The layer that removed a candidate when nothing qualifies

policy.description: What an admin may open per content class (section 8.3)
policy.catalog: a remote backend by choosing one in the desk's models table
policy.rows: a remote backend only with a recorded acknowledgement that rows of the archive will leave the site
policy.identifiers: never remote; a request whose user text matches an identifier shape is bumped to identifiers for that request and runs local
